name: Zip-NeRF Hash Encoding with Gaussian Expectation
definition: A spatial encoding method for NeRF that replaces large MLPs with a multi-scale hash grid to store 3D features, using Gaussian expectation approximation to prevent aliasing during grid queries.
summary: Zip-NeRF Hash Encoding with Gaussian Expectation accelerates NeRFs by replacing large MLPs with multi-scale hash grids and using Gaussian expectation to prevent aliasing artifacts.
